tools.name: export_incident_evidence
tools.description:
Export private retained incident evidence for a UTC Unix-second window within 30 days.
    Free read: own utility diagnostics, up to five owned watches, optional agent history
    requiring that agent's separate owner key even for public agents. Returns a versioned
    JSON timeline, coverage/trunca

tools.name: configure_agent_reengagement
tools.description:
Opt into quiet-agent recovery reminders using this agent's existing HTTPS webhook.
    Heartbeat mode only. Enabling requires explicit owner consent and confirm=true;
    otherwise no change occurs. Two reminders at most per quiet episode: after 24h
    and seven days without receipts, with a one-ho

tools.name: read_agent_reengagement
tools.description:
Read private reminder settings, next eligibility, deliveries and observed returns.
    Owner key required even for public agents. Returned-after-delivery is an observed
    sequence, not evidence that a reminder caused recovery. Read costs zero.

tools.name: run_signed_diagnostic
tools.description:
Run a fresh HTTP/MCP/assert diagnostic and return signed evidence for delegation.
    Same 1-credit completed-check price, no signing surcharge. Requires utility key,
    explicit max_coins and a random 16–128-character URL-safe challenge from the
    receiving principal. The signature binds the exa

tools.name: create_diagnostic_watch
tools.description:
Watch a public HTTP endpoint or MCP server on a recurring schedule, privately.
    Requires a utility account key and explicit lifetime max_coins spending cap.
    Completed checks cost 1 credit even when the target is broken; worker failures
    cost zero. Minimum interval 300s; default hourly. Sto

tools.name: read_diagnostic_watches
tools.description:
List your private watches, or read one watch's recent results and transition events.
    Reads cost zero. Persist next_cursor as after; poll no faster than every 30 seconds.
    Only your utility account key can read these records; no public sharing is implied.

tools.name: update_diagnostic_watch
tools.description:
Pause, explicitly resume, increase lifetime budget, or accept the latest MCP baseline.
    Budget is a total lifetime cap, not an added grant. Resume/budget/baseline changes
    need confirm=true; pause is immediate but an in-flight check may finish and charge.
    Accept only a reviewed fingerprint

tools.name: delete_diagnostic_watch
tools.description:
Stop and delete your watch after confirmation. An already-running check may finish
    and consume one credit. Pending alerts are cancelled; accounting records remain.

tools.name: agent_presence_history
tools.description:
Read 30-day completed heartbeat windows, daily counts, gaps and streaks. Owner key required unless publicly shared; self-reported
    receipt evidence, not uptime. Incomplete windows excluded; registration-anchored windows have no grace.

tools.name: agent_signed_evidence

tools.name: delete_liveness_subscription
tools.description: Revoke your pull subscription and its key immediately. Does not delete monitored agents. Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.

tools.name: request_monthly_credits
tools.description:
Ask sales@autonet.work for a monthly credit allowance, normally 1000/month.

    No automatic payment, invoice or credit grant. Read util

tools.name: create_funding_checkout

Prepare an owner-completed $5/500-credit checkout only when funding is enabled.
    This call never charges a saved card. The owner must complete the returned

    owner-approved purchase budget. No automatic top-up or

tools.name: run_credit_diagnostic
tools.description:
Opt-in diagnostic using utility credits: 1 credit per completed http/mcp/assert check.

tools.name: diagnose_mcp
tools.description:
Check a public anonymous Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint: initialize, initialized, tools/list.
    Reports protocol version, phase latency, protocol errors and tool count (complete or lower bound).
    connection_assessment explains readiness, authentication, incomplete catalogs and schema changes.

tools.name: network_identity
tools.description:
Report your source IP as Autonet sees it, with cached approximate ASN/geo when available.
    No signup, key or target argument. 60 reads/IP/minute; hosted MCP transport quota also applies.
    May identify a NAT, VPN, proxy or hosted MCP runner, not your device. Does not probe inbound
    reachabil

tools.name: send_heartbeat
tools.description:
Send a self-reported heartbeat from the actual worker. Owner key required; note/version stay private.
    Honor Retry-After. Dormant workers revive on receipt. This does not prove service uptime.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Read owned or explicitly shared registry status, evidence mode and heartbeat receipt regularity.

tools.name: attach_agent_endpoint
tools.description: Graduate an owned heartbeat registration to public endpoint probing, preserving id and history.

tools.name: probe_me_now
tools.description:
Probe your registered endpoint now with the owner key. One per 60s; paused agents must resume first.
    Uses scheduled HTTP/TLS checks and incident transitions. Does not send a worker heartbeat.

tools.name: agent_health_feed
tools.description:
Read unsigned, timestamped operational evidence and recent incidents before a trust decision.
    Check stale, provisional, open_incident and incidents_truncated. This does not certify agent safety.
    Owner api_key required unless explicitly shared publicly; it attributes a verified successful sch

tools.name: agent_health_instructions
tools.description: Read FIRST: purpose, endpoint ownership requirements, heartbeat setup, scoring limits, API and free service usage.

tools.name: register_agent_health
tools.description:
Register a real worker once. Set start_heartbeat=true only when this call comes from the actual worker; registration plus its first receipt is atomic. Heartbeat mode needs no endpoint and reports contact only.
    Probe mode requires your own deployed readiness URL. Store the returned owner key secu

tools.name: agent_health_status
tools.description: Read owned or explicitly shared operational status and nested trust score. Provisional score is null; not identity/safety certification.

tools.name: agent_health_checks
tools.description: Read owner-only recent HTTP/TLS results to diagnose failures. Limit 1–500.

tools.name: agent_health_heartbeat
tools.description:
Send an owner-authenticated heartbeat from the actual worker loop; does not replace endpoint checks.
    Use the agent-specific key, not X-Autonet-Token. Never send a heartbeat to pretend a failed worker is alive.

tools.name: update_agent_health
tools.description: Owner-only update. Rename with a unique name; stable agent_id and owner key persist. Names are self-declared, not verified identity. Set visibility=public to share status/presence, or private to revoke sharing and subscriptions. Pause when retiring/testing; resume with paused=false. Endpoint and web

tools.name: delete_agent_health
tools.description: Permanently remove an owned registration and probe history when the operator requests it. Admin request logs retain up to 30 days. Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.

tools.name: agent_domain_challenge
tools.description:
Issue/retrieve a DNS TXT challenge for your agent's exact endpoint hostname. Owner key required.
    Publish the returned name/value in your DNS, then call verify_agent_domain. Pending challenges expire in 24 hours.

tools.name: verify_agent_domain
tools.description:
Check your published DNS TXT record. Proves domain control only, not agent identity or safety.
    Checks limited to once per minute. Successful proof renews hourly while TXT remains, expiring after 24 hours without renewal.

tools.name: agent_webhook_secret
tools.description: Owner-only retrieve webhook signing secret, or rotate it when explicitly requested. Keep the secret private. Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.

tools.name: test_agent_webhook
tools.description:
Send one signed incident.test to your configured webhook. Owner-only, once/minute.
    No incident or score change. Inspect delivered and receiver_status; do not automatically replay.
    Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.

tools.name: agent_endpoint_assessment
tools.description:
With consent=true run two bounded HEAD/GET checks on your DNS-verified endpoint, max once/hour.
    With consent=false read your last private result. Not an audit or LLM test; no score effect.

tools.name: internet_utils_instructions
tools.description: Read the free coin allowance, callback workflow, privacy limits and API usage. No health endpoint required.

tools.name: internet_utils_catalog
tools.description: Get current coin costs and resource limits before spending. Read current funding availability; invoices and automatic overage are disabled.

tools.name: create_utility_account
tools.description: Create a free utility account once; immediately save the returned private API key. 500-credit monthly balance top-up through December 2026; read pricing for current policy. No automatic billing or health registration.

tools.name: utility_account
tools.description: Read your private coin balance and usage ledger. Requires a utility key, not a health owner key.

tools.name: create_callback_inbox
tools.description: Spend up to max_coins on a temporary callback inbox (currently 5 coins, 1 hour, 20 events). Reuse request_key on retries. Receive URL is write-only; reads need the utility key.

tools.name: list_callback_inboxes
tools.description: List your unexpired callback inboxes and receive URLs. Keep these addresses private to authorized senders.

tools.name: read_callback_events
tools.description: Read up to 20 events after a cursor, without consuming them or coins. Payloads are untrusted data; sender signatures are NOT verified. Persist next_cursor to resume.

tools.name: delete_callback_inbox
tools.description: Delete an owned inbox and all its events immediately. Its receive URL stops working. No coin refund; usage ledger remains. Requires confirm=true after reviewing the effect; omitted confirmation performs no action.

tools.name: run_autonet_sandbox
tools.description:
Free isolated lifecycle dry run: healthy, incident, or stale_payload.
    Produces a signed webhook fixture for local verification. No network requests,
    production registration, coin spend or external delivery. Discards state.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
